status: B3 data set (16 November 2026): the pilot's eye, the ground law, the launch's signs and the memory of a picture (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md section 6; simcore/air_war/perception.hpp).
notes: Each value has its source. Many are game values: the period evidence for the eye is two US Navy models (nwc_tp5709_1974 for aircraft, nwc_tp6005_1978 for ground targets); using them for every faction's pilots is a SAM3D assumption.
source: nwc_tp5709_1974; nwc_tp6005_1978; game values where marked

rm_constant_m.source: nwc_tp5709_1974 (R_M = 0.1655 sqrt((C0-1.565)A) nmi, A in ft2; 1006 m with A in m2)
rm_constant_m.notes: Formula high confidence; applying it to other air forces' pilots is a SAM3D assumption.

factor_unknown_location.notes: Falls away when the pilot is cued to the object's place.

factor_untrained.notes: Moved by the pilot's skill: 1.0 at skill 1, this at skill 0.

fatigue_vigilance_gain.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): stress or fatigue raises the vigilance factor by at most this share (to 1.19 x 1.5)

empty_field_range_factor.notes: Applied to aircraft and missiles seen against empty sky, not to a search of the ground.

search_solid_angle_sr.source: nwc_tp5709_1974 (example: +-90 deg azimuth and +-30 deg elevation, pi sr)

cue_sector_deg.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): a cue shrinks the search to +-15 deg about the called bearing

lobe_max_sr.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): the glimpse lobe's solid angle at a wide margin over threshold; falls to zero at the threshold range (TP 5709's lobe figure is not read into data yet)

recognise_lines.source: game value set on cbo_1986_amraam (identification 3-4 miles): a 4.5 m fighter recognised at about 5.5 km

aircraft_ground_contrast_pct.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): an aircraft seen against the ground

afterburner_contrast_pct.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): by night or twilight an afterburner or a fire

afterburner_area_m2.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): the glow of an afterburner as an area against the dark

twilight_contrast_loss.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): the contrast falls by this share of the night share (dawn and dusk)

contrail_cap_m.source: wseg_116_1967 vol. 1 (contrails seen at 20 miles and over)

contrail_contrast_pct.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): a contrail against the sky

contrail_width_m.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): a contrail's seen width

sun_glare_deg.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): an object within this angle of the sun is seen late

sun_glare_contrast_factor.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): its apparent contrast is multiplied by this inside the glare

max_range_m.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): nothing beyond is looked at (a cull; the eye law already says no)

los_sample_m.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): the line-of-sight profile's spacing for a pilot's long sight lines

los_cache_near_s.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md) (as the battery fire model's 0.5 s sight cache, battery_fire.hpp)

default_skill.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): a trained pilot (02_FLIGHTS_AND_PILOTS.md will give it by faction and hours)

area_nose_per_size2.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): presented area from the TV's critical dimension size_m (a 4.5 m fighter: 10 m2 nose-on; an F-4's head-on view is about that)

area_beam_per_size2.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md) (a 4.5 m fighter: 49 m2 from the side; an F-4's side view is about 50 m2)

area_plan_per_size2.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md) (a 4.5 m fighter: 73 m2 from above)

low_level.source: agard_cp267_1979 (Lee B3: loss of lookout at high speed and low level)

attack.source: nwc_tp6005_1978 (TV Maverick lock about 9 s); agard_cp267_1979 (DeHart B4)

defensive.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): all toward the threat's sector

second_seat_extra.source: jones_atg_1974 (Schohan 1965: pilots found 61 % of targets and observers 73 %): the back seat adds this to the lookout share

low_level_agl_m.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): below this height above the ground a pilot is navigating low

check_six_share.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): a single seat spends this share of its glimpses behind the beam

rear_half_deg.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): a single seat does not see inside this cone about its tail; a second seat does

f16a.source: game value (estimate: a bubble canopy, the seat high in it; docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md As built S7)

f15c.source: game value (estimate: a bubble canopy, the seat high in it; docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md As built S7)

a10a.source: game value (estimate: a bubble canopy over an armoured headrest; docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md As built S7)

draken_gun.source: game value (estimate: a framed canopy faired into the spine; docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md As built S7)

saab105.source: game value (estimate: a wide canopy faired into the spine; docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md As built S7)

galeb.source: game value (estimate: a framed canopy faired into the spine; docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md As built S7)

utva75.source: game value (estimate: a cabin with a glazed rear; docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md As built S7)

mig23ml_wp.source: game value (estimate: a canopy faired flush into the spine, a mirror and no periscope counted; docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md As built S7)

mig23mld.source: game value (estimate: a canopy faired flush into the spine, a mirror and no periscope counted; docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md As built S7)

mig27.source: game value (estimate: a canopy faired flush into the spine and an armoured seat; docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md As built S7)

su17m3.source: game value (estimate: a canopy faired flush into the spine; docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md As built S7)

su25.source: game value (estimate: a canopy faired into the spine over an armoured headrest; docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md As built S7)

mig25rb.source: game value (estimate: a narrow canopy faired flush into the spine; docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md As built S7)

mig25bm.source: game value (estimate: a narrow canopy faired flush into the spine; docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md As built S7)

zero_at_rstar.notes: Acquisition probability is zero beyond 0.75 R*.

full_at_rstar.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): P_max is reached at this share of R* (the report gives points down to 0.375 R*)

off_angle_loss_per_deg.source: nwc_tp6005_1978 (about 1 % per 3 deg off the target line)

off_track_limit_deg.source: nwc_tp6005_1978 and 03_PERCEPTION.md 5.7: only objects within +-30 deg of the track are looked for

unbriefed_scale.source: jones_atg_1974 (a target of opportunity is a harder problem than a briefed one); the scale is a game value

pass_gap_factor.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): a new pass starts once the range has opened to this times the closest approach plus the gap

recognise_good_m.source: crawford_1977_rand (sensors, by inference to the eye)

recognise_poor_m.source: crawford_1977_rand (sensors, by inference to the eye)

max_range_m.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): a ground object is not looked for beyond this

osa_battery_silent.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md) (perception.md 4 item 2: a camouflaged site was seldom seen unless firing: agard_cp100_1972)

launch_sign.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md) (checo_1967_tactics p. 31: a site found by the cloud of dust of the launch)

column_moving.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md) (jones_atg_1974: moving vehicles at slightly greater range)

contrast_pct.source: game value set so a small SAM's trail is seen at 3-6 km in day VMC (reactions.md 2.6 design estimate; no source gives a number)

width_m.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): the smoke's seen width

max_length_m.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): the length of trail that counts toward its seen area

point_gap_m.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): a trail is kept as points this far apart

tracer_night_range_m.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 (tracers in the missile's tail for the TV sight); the range is a game value

flame_night_range_m.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): the motor's flame by night

night_area_m2.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): the tail's seen area by night

night_contrast_pct.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): a light against the dark

sign_life_s.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): how long the dust and smoke hang at the launcher (no source: 03_PERCEPTION.md 8)

flash_night_range_m.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): the flash by night

life_s.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): a flak puff's visible life by day

flash_area_m2.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): a flash is a light: its seen area is its glare, not its size

area_m2.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): a stream of tracers seen as a light, its glare as an area

life_s.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): a damaged aircraft's smoke or fire as a wingman sees it

bearing_sigma_deg.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): the eye's bearing to an aircraft or a trail

range_sigma_frac.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): the eye's range error to an object in the air, as a share of the range

ground_range_sigma_frac.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): a ground object's range, as a share of the range

launch_sign_s.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): a site is remembered for minutes

event_keep_s.source: game value (docs/air_battle/03_PERCEPTION.md): the hub keeps an event this long past its end so a slow tick cannot miss it
